itemUsage.en: Supporter operator Frozendelta uses his craft to trade for life's necessities.
itemUsage.zh: 辅助干员冻河，用技艺为自己换取生活的必需。

itemDesc.en: From then on, he has nothing left, yet possesses everything.
itemDesc.zh: 自此，他既一无所有，亦无所不有。

description.en: Applies a <$ba.triggereffect>Trigger Effect</> to <@ba.vup>{max_target}</> operators within range (only targets without this effect will be chosen):\nWhen attacked, gain a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to <@ba.vup>{shield_atk_scale:0%}</> of Frozendelta's ATK (decays over {shield_time}s) and <$ba.stun>Stun</> the attacker for <@ba.vup>{stun}</>s
description.zh: 对范围内<@ba.vup>{max_target}</>名干员施加<$ba.triggereffect>触发型效果</>（只选择未持有该效果的目标）：\n受到攻击时，获得相当于冻河<@ba.vup>{shield_atk_scale:0%}</>攻击力的<$ba.barrier>屏障</>（在{shield_time}秒内衰减），并使攻击者<$ba.stun>晕眩</><@ba.vup>{stun}</>秒

description.en: Attack Speed <@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>, attacks deal Physical damage equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</> of ATK to {attack@max_target} enemies and <$ba.stun>Stun</> the targets for <@ba.vup>{attack@stun:0.0}</>s, immediately applies a <$ba.triggereffect>Trigger Effect</> to another operator within range (triggers it instead if it already exists):\nUpon skill activation, increases self and Frozendelta's ATK by <@ba.vup>+{bonus_init_atk:0%}</> (decays over <@ba.vup>{bonus_duration}</>s) and transfers the <$ba.triggereffect>Trigger Effect</> to another operator within Frozendelta's attack range with the highest SP percentage; during Frozendelta's skill, the operator with this effect gains <@ba.vup>1</> SP per second
description.zh: 攻击速度<@ba.vup>+{attack_speed}</>，攻击对{attack@max_target}个敌人造成攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害并使目标<$ba.stun>晕眩</><@ba.vup>{attack@stun:0.0}</>秒，立刻对范围内另一名干员施加<$ba.triggereffect>触发型效果</>（已存在时改为将其触发）：\n开启技能时自身和冻河攻击力<@ba.vup>+{bonus_init_atk:0%}</>（在<@ba.vup>{bonus_duration}</>秒内衰减），并将该<$ba.triggereffect>触发型效果</>转移给冻河攻击范围内技力比例最高的另一名干员；冻河技能期间拥有该效果的干员每秒获得<@ba.vup>1</>点技力
